chunks: 2405 - And it is narrated from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: Is travel disliked on any of the days regarded as unfavorable, such as Wednesday and others?
So he عليه السلام said: "Begin your journey with charity, depart whenever it seems right to you, recite Ayat al-Kursi, and undergo cupping if it seems appropriate to you."

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: the Throne Verse recited for protection and blessing
key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charity given at the outset of travel

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to travel on supposedly unfavorable days like Wednesday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a believer should not be overly constrained by beliefs about unfavorable days for travel. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام directs the questioner toward trust in Allah through charity, recitation of Ayat al-Kursi, and practical preparation before setting out.
